title: Content-Addressed Evidence ZIP Export and Artifact Byte Reconciliation
checks: Create deterministic locally exported ZIP with sorted entries, fixed metadata and stable compression choice
Inspect ZIP without extracting files, reject duplicate entries, directory traversal, absolute paths, symlinks, excessive entries and oversized files
Hash observed raw ZIP bytes and each observed evidence entry with SHA-256
Pin exact Git source SHA to commit.txt, AETHER-218 native-gate JSON and AETHER-219 manifest JSON
Reject missing required compiler, test, CLI or manifest evidence; reject unsuccessful gate or attempted ACT promotion
Keep local CI export ZIP distinguished from the archive actually issued by GitHub Actions upload-artifact
Never mark successful native execution or remote immutable retention based solely on a local ZIP or self-declared manifest
Preserve exact failure evidence rather than repairing historical Phase XVIII status
execution_limitation: No actual GitHub-hosted artifact ZIP retrieved or independently hashed; all real-run qualification remains unverified.
